# Gas giant: r 1.5 banded ball and a tilted cyan ring 4.5 m across. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Cream --base-color 0.9843 0.7451 0.5098 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 0.9373 0.4314 0.0627 --no-slot
material new Ring --base-color 0.3686 0.9137 0.9137 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Giant --subdivisions 2 --radius 1.5
material assign Cream
active Giant
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 17
mode object
active Giant
mode edit
select mode face
select none
select face where "abs(pos.z - 0.55) < 0.22 || abs(pos.z + 0.35) < 0.18"
material assign Band
mode object
add mesh torus --name Ring --major-segments 20 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 2.25 --minor-radius 0.16
scale 1 1 0.3
apply --scale
set rotation 16 0 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 -20 0
apply --rotation
material assign Ring
select all
shade flat
export giant.glb
